product_or_collection: Greatest Hits Sample Bundle (5 x 12-serving loose leaf pouches or tea bag option, giftable box)
personalized_store_observation: Sample bundles such as Greatest Hits come as 5 loose leaf pouches or a tea bag option in a giftable box; single teas come in multiple sizes (e.g. 35g pouch, 75g jar, 200g pouch).
inventory_order_automation_opportunity: Bundle component inventory sync with low-stock alerts per blend
opportunity_reasoning: Bundles and single-tea variants likely share pouch stock; holiday gifting raises bundle volume, so automatic component deduction and threshold alerts keep counts accurate.
personalized_subject: Sample bundle stock idea for Pluck Tea
personalized_email_body:
Hi Jennifer,

I was browsing Pluck Tea's sample bundles and noticed the Greatest Hits bundle comes as five loose leaf pouches or a tea bag option, packed in a giftable box. With the holiday season approaching, bundles like this often draw on the same pouch stock as your single teas, so counts can shift quickly.

I build Shopify automation systems that help stores simplify inventory updates, order processing, and supplier notifications. One idea: when a bundle sells, automatically deduct each component pouch from stock and send you a low-stock alert once any single blend drops below a level you choose.

Would component-level tracking for your bundles be useful this season?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Shopify Automation & Integration Specialist
